note: Tbilisi tram facts checked by Claude on 2026-11-18 against ka.wikipedia (Tbilisi tram), ru.wikipedia (Tbilisi tram), en.wikipedia (Trams in Tbilisi). Gemini draft (for_gemini/outbox/tram_routes.json, opened=false) was checked claim by claim; only what a page states is kept.

confirmed.konka: opened 1883 (ru 10 March, en 3 April); first line along Mikhailovsky (now Aghmashenebeli) avenue between Vorontsov Square and the railway station; ended 1910; 914 mm (ru.wikipedia). ka.wikipedia: the original tram route repeated the konka route.
confirmed.first_electric_line: 25 December 1904 (ru, ka); gauge 1000 mm (ru, ka); streets of the electric line are NOT named (the Kirochnaya line of 1904 is in the konka paragraph on ru and ka)
confirmed.regauging: to 1524 mm from 1933, metre-gauge sections until 1942 (ru, ka, en 1933-1942)
confirmed.first_broad_gauge_line: 15 February 1934, Meat Combine - Shaumyan Square (ru only)
confirmed.closing: 4 December 2006 for the whole tram system (ru, ka, en); the last route was No 12; 8 routes in 2000 (11, 12, 3, 4, 1, 2, 6, 7), 4 routes in 2003 (11, 12, 1, 7) (ru)
